identity.name: prism
identity.description: Multi-faceted content classification for any dada.stream content envelope.

capabilities.description: Applies topics, subtopics, freeform tags, sentiment, and intent to content envelopes.

commands.name: classify-content
commands.description: Classify a single content envelope. Returns the enriched classification section.

response.description: Classification section written to the envelope.

commands.name: reclassify-content
commands.description: Re-classify an envelope with the current topics/models, useful after taxonomy changes.

response.description: Newly written classification section; the prior one is retained as a run record.

commands.name: get-classification
commands.description: Return the current classification for an envelope.

response.description: Current classification section, or 404 if the envelope has not been classified.

commands.name: list-topics
commands.description: Return the active topic taxonomy with subtopics.

response.description: List of topics, each with id, displayName, definition, and subtopics.

commands.name: get-low-confidence
commands.description: Return envelopes awaiting inbox review (low-confidence classifications). Each item carries the runId of the specific proposal being shown, which accept/edit must echo back.

response.description: Envelopes whose most recent classification fell below the confidence threshold, each with its runId and proposal hash, ordered for inbox triage.

commands.name: accept-classification
commands.description: Accept a specific proposed classification (identified by runId) as user-confirmed; promotes it to the labeled set.

parameters.name: runId
parameters.description: The run whose proposal the reviewer saw. If a newer run has superseded it, the request is rejected as stale — the reviewer is redirected to the fresh proposal.

response.description: Label record written, including the accepted facets, the runId it was anchored to, and the labeler identity. Repeat calls for the same (envelopeId, runId) return the existing label record unchanged.

commands.name: edit-classification
commands.description: Override facets of a specific proposed classification (identified by runId). User correction.

parameters.name: runId
parameters.description: The run whose proposal the reviewer saw. Stale runIds are rejected; the reviewer is redirected to the latest proposal to re-edit.

response.description: Updated classification section and the label record persisting the correction, anchored to the submitted runId.

commands.name: run-eval
commands.description: Run the eval harness against the held-out labeled set.

response.description: Eval run ID plus per-facet metric summaries and diffs against the baseline run when provided.

publishes.description: Classification was attempted but fell below threshold — candidate for review.

subscribes.description: Triggers classification when new content enters the system.

required.name: SCRAPER_DB_PATH
required.description: Path to x-sync SQLite for v1 envelope mapping.

infrastructure: event-bus (optional in v1 — polled outbox instead)
